_comment: THE shipping contract for A&B Motors. One file decides four things that used to be
spelled out separately and were free to disagree: what checkout charges (delivery
profiles, scripts/setup_shipping.py), what the product page warns (the ship:* tag on
the product), which parts fall in which group, and who closes an invoiced order out.
CoreYard reads this through STORE_SHIPPING_POLICY_FILE and applies each part's tag
during the publish that creates the product — so a part is never live and sellable
wearing the wrong shipping, or none. It understands the schema generically; it knows
nothing about A&B.
Groups are tried in 'match_order', first substring hit wins, case-insensitive against
the part type. So a specific pattern must come before a general one. GROUND carries
"default": true and catches everything unmatched.
'fulfillment' says who ships it: 'external' means ShipStation buys the label and will
close the fulfillment order itself, so `coreyard orders sync-status` must NOT fulfill
it early or the buyer loses their tracking email. 'yard' means nobody else ever will.
Keep the freight lists tight — a freight charge on a part that could have gone ground
loses the sale outright.
CHANGING A TAG REPUBLISHES THE PARTS IT COVERS: the tag is part of the rendered
product, so the sync sees them as changed. Run `bin/coreyard --sink api --dry-run`
first. After changing rates or patterns, re-run scripts/setup_shipping.py --apply so
the delivery profiles still agree, and scripts/check_contracts.py to confirm the theme
still matches.

PICKUP.label: Pickup only
PICKUP.note: Body panels and glass. We do not ship these at any price — they arrive damaged and cost more to crate than they are worth. Local pickup at the yard only.

A.label: Freight — oversize
A.note: Engines, transmissions, axles, and K-frames. Ships by LTL freight to a commercial address.

B.label: Freight — heavy
B.note: Transfer cases and differential carriers. Ships by LTL freight to a commercial address.

GROUND.label: Free ground
GROUND.note: Ships free anywhere in the lower 48, with UPS calculated offered as a paid option. Free local delivery around Amite.
